title: Deeper/broader new DWG render-pipeline and shared-lineage review
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Screen a newly surfaced DWG-to-image application against the current open-source parser and consumer map
Determine whether it adds an independent DWG/DXF parser, writer, or 3D semantic route
Update the existing optional comparator guidance without expanding implementation or per-slice validation

method.kind: Read primary project README, architecture, capability limits, and repository release metadata
method.limitations: The dwg2png project page and README are mutable and provide no release artifact or per-file input hashes/run receipt for the reported corpus. No executable or drawing was obtained or tested; all route capabilities and corpus results remain project-reported.

sources.revision: Mutable main/repository page reviewed 2026-10-18; no release artifact listed
sources.observed: The README describes an acadrust parser stage followed by application-owned tessellation, page/viewport projection, rendering, and metadata extraction. Its listed rendered entity set includes common 2D geometry, text, attributes, blocks, and paper-space viewport projection. It explicitly lists HATCH, DIMENSION geometry, LEADER/MLEADER, MLINE, raster images, and 3D solids as not rendered; splines may use fit points or a control polygon. It self-reports 11 AC1032 inputs and 23 rendered pages compared with plotted PDFs, without per-file hashes or an independently authored expected geometry manifest on the reviewed page.

sources.revision: Existing local review baseline; no peer source re-executed in this pass
sources.observed: The plan already separates parser lineage, directional file-format operations, downstream projection, carrier preservation, and independent solid semantics. The new application routes through the already-counted ACadRust lineage and does not close the existing independent parser, native-consumer, or geometry-semantic gates.

assessment.planImpact: Records dwg2png as an optional ACadRust-lineage downstream 2D projection/renderer discovery route only. It is not an independent DWG/DXF codec, native CAD acceptance result, or 3D/ACIS semantic witness. No required gate, implementation order, or validation cadence changed.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not add dwg2png to ordinary fast slices, CMake, CI, fixture storage, or the required native matrix.
If a concrete 2D projection discrepancy later justifies its use, pin source commit, Cargo.lock dependency/source identities, toolchain, and exact operation before running it.
Use only locally authored or otherwise authorized inputs with hashes and an independent page/geometry expectation; record every source handle and unsupported/omitted disposition.
Attribute parser decode, application tessellation, page/viewport projection, rendering, and metadata as separate stages. Do not count ACadRust-based apps as independent DWG parser votes.
Treat screenshots, self-reported PDF comparisons, text/metadata extraction, and outputs that omit 3D solids as projection observations only, never as carrier or B-rep validation.
Keep findings 130/73 and J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; source discovery does not promote any support claim.
